Subject: Request to defer May ramp and discuss pro‑ration on order form

Connor —

Quick one from our finance/ops side. We appreciate Redwood's flexibility on the initial pilot pricing, but internal budget timing has shifted and BrightLane needs to push the main capacity ramp from June 1 → July 15. That changes expected consumption for Q2 and we're trying to avoid paying full month fees for June when we won't be at the committed throughput.

Can your team do a pro‑rated adjustment to the order form for June (we'd still take reduced capacity in June and then ramp to committed levels in July)? Evan is copied — he's our procurement lead and can share expected daily usage curves.

We attached a redline of the order form with suggested language for a pro‑ration clause and a short proposed schedule revision. Would like to get to a legal tidy‑up and signature this week if possible.

Attachments: BrightLane_OrderForm_Redline_v2.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightLane

1) Exact commitment levels for the partial June month (daily average throughput or node count)
2) How credits or reduced fees are calculated (pro‑rated by days vs. consumption‑based true‑up)
3) Signatory/approval path (BrightLane legal sign and Redwood lead for this change)

Irene is on the thread to coordinate the legal wording. Karthik — please confirm if finance needs a particular billing token or invoice flow for this adjustment.

Subject: Re: Request to defer May ramp and discuss pro‑ration on order form

Hi all —

Thanks for the materials. Reviewed both attachments. High‑level guidance and proposed language below. I've kept the edit minimal to avoid reopening the whole MSA.

1) Proposed approach: accept a days‑based pro‑ration for June with an explicit clause that: (a) any usage above the adjusted commitment is billed at the standard per‑unit rate and (b) a final consumption true‑up will be performed for June and July at the end of July.

2) Suggested replacement clause (single paragraph to insert into the Order Form):

"For the partial billing period commencing June 1, 2028 and ending June 30, 2028, the Parties agree that the Monthly Commitment Fee will be pro‑rated based on the number of calendar days the reduced commitment is in effect. BrightLane will pay the pro‑rated fee for June, plus any overage fees calculated at the standard per‑unit rates. A consumption true‑up will occur on July 31, 2028 to reconcile actual usage in June and July; any shortfall or overage will be reflected on the August invoice."

3) MSA interplay: I recommend adding a short cross‑reference to MSA §6.2 to avoid conflicting interpretations. I have tracked two small edits in the attached Word doc (MSA_extract_section6_trackchanges.docx).

4) Commercial notes: require a signatory on the order form that explicitly references this revised schedule; we should also lock the invoice schedule so finance can issue a corrected June invoice.

No material legal risk in the approach; main thing is ensuring the true‑up timing and that we keep the minimum monthly commitment language.

Attachments: MSA_extract_section6_trackchanges.docx

If everyone is good, Connor — please confirm final numeric commitment for June (Evan?) and we'll generate a single redline for DocuSign.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
